bar.name: v1 HTML fixtures and A2UI for the same apps; 300 blind English requests; independent end-to-end attack on stored rows

biggest_gap: No S1 this round. Undo bookkeeping: `lastChange` stays set after undo() and setField, so the next change on the same input joins an older undo step and Undo removes a row the user never undid. Form drafts are keyed by field name and do not follow safe edits.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: mo.mjs check over 30 examples and 300 corpus programs: 330 OK. Coverage of unseen requests not re-measured.
300 corpus programs: keyword tokenizer median 133, p90 239, max 811.

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: Prefix test passes inside 549/549; fuzz-check 20,000 mutations on a fresh seed: 0 crashes.

acceptance.line: edits never lose or retype saved data while marked safe
acceptance.evidence: No rows, settings or picks lost or merged in 94k critic steps over 56 programs driven through the UI tree. But a safe field rename strands a typed form draft, a new default field blocks Add on an old draft, and an option rename leaves a text state on the old name while marked safe.

other_notes: S2: saves from before round 8 and data-only restores load with `touched` unset, so an app holding rows accepts another app's backup.

S3: setField accepts empty on a required field and a dangling ref id; echo of '' stores null; non-numeric input on a num stores null, 0 or 1; `when` re-fires after reload; rows added by timers are removed by Undo of an earlier tap.
All six round 7 faults confirmed fixed. Four hand-computed programs match the evaluator.
